downloadedSource.method: Compare transpiled syntax trees excluding comments, source positions, punctuation and redundant parenthesis nodes. Runtime-relevant identifier/literal text, operators, declaration kind and child structure are retained. Also normalizes associative logical operators preserving operand order and the optional enclosing block around a sole for-of statement. This is a review aid, not formal equivalence proof.
